goal: Make Pesaje parameters per-country/per-run (not one global config) and support the iterate loop: configure → run → review stats/CSV → adjust params → re-run (even after success) → mark as listo (reuse JAA-391 close).
decisions: Marcar como listo = cerrar proceso (reuse useSetProcessStatus/closeProcess, ProcessStatusBadge); no new state.
Config lives per-card, pre-filled from that country's last run parameters_json (or DEFAULT). Global gear removed.
Re-run with edited params is allowed after a COMPLETED run, not only after a failure. When the process is closed, re-run is not offered.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: PesajePage header no longer renders the global 'Parametros de pesaje' gear; each country card exposes its own 'Configurar parametros' control that opens a per-country param dialog.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: PesajePage renders no button with aria-label 'Parametros de pesaje'; WeightingCountryCard renders a 'Configurar parametros' trigger. e2e: clicking it on a card opens the params dialog.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A card's config dialog is pre-filled from that country's last run parameters_json; falls back to DEFAULT_WEIGHTING_PARAMS when the country has no runs.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: render card with a latest run whose parameters_json sets METODO_BOUNDS='iqr' → opening the dialog shows iqr selected; render card with no runs → shows percentile (default).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Editing a card's params then running posts THAT card's params; params are independent per country.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e: open Argentina config, set MAX_ROUNDS_COLAPSO to a distinctive value + METODO_BOUNDS='iqr', Ejecutar → assert POST /weighting/runs body.parameters reflects those values; a second country still posts its own/default values.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: After a COMPLETED run the detail modal allows editing parameters and 'Re-ejecutar' (not only after a failure).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e: run a country to completed, open 'Ver detalle', confirm Parametros are editable, change a value, 'Re-ejecutar' → a new run is created/executed (toast 'Re-ejecucion iniciada').

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A completed, open country can be 'Marcado como listo' which closes the pesaje process; Ejecutar becomes disabled; reopening via the badge re-enables iteration.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e: with a completed run, click 'Marcar como listo' → confirm → process badge shows 'Cerrado' and Ejecutar is disabled (title 'Proceso cerrado'); click badge → 'Abrir proceso' → Ejecutar enabled again.
npm test (vitest) all pass, npm run lint clean, npx tsc -b clean.
